# Event

## Summary
Something that happens at a time, usually at a place, usually with an
audience. Shared-realm block at `event.gts`. What KIND of happening (a
match, a gig, an open day) is the consumer's `kind` label; the domain's
extras (opponent, headliner, home/away) live on the consumer's extending
card.

## API
- `title`, `kind`, `description`
- `startsAt` / `endsAt` — DateTimeFields (instants; an all-day event is one whose consumer chose not to render the times)
- `venue` — linksTo Location
- `capacity` — the Capacity field: the configured ceiling and named slices
- `status` — Draft / Scheduled / Live / Completed / Cancelled (`EventStatusField`, also exported; Cancelled can be reinstated — postponements do exactly this)

Embedded and fitted lead with a date block — events are found by date
first, name second.

## Usage
```ts
import { Event, EventStatusField } from '../event';

class Match extends Event { /* opponent, homeAway, competition */ }
```

## Non-goals
How much is booked against the capacity is live Booking data the consumer
queries — never stored here. Recurrence (weekly classes) is a schedule
concern, one level up: a recurring thing GENERATES events, it is not an
event with a repeat flag. Ticket pricing tiers and sales windows are
selling concerns for the consumer.
